description: DeepSeek Pro assistant self-report defaults: Fluid 1.499 bits, 32.4/50 Agreeableness, 36% MBTI tie rate, and inline hook rules.
h1: DeepSeek Pro: assistant self-report defaults, trajectory, and tuning rules.
dek: Fixture preview: Fluid open-weight baseline (1.499 bits B5 entropy, 32.4/50 Agreeableness, 1.4% reverse-key contradictions) requiring multi-run sampling and inline hooks.
lede: Across five DeepSeek Pro checkpoints (Chat v3 through V4 Pro 0813) under fixed zero-memory elicitation, Big Five item entropy reaches 1.499 bits—roughly 9.7x higher than Crystalline proprietary baselines—and Agreeableness sits 14.4 points lower (32.4/50). Because modal MBTI share (42%) overlaps the runner-up (28%) within binomial 95% CI, single-label headlines are suppressed.
answer: Assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation place DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 in the Fluid tier (H_MM = 1.499 bits, 34/50 unique Big Five vectors, 36% MBTI tie rate, headline_allowed = false). Agreeableness averages 32.4/50 (10-50 B5) and IPIP-HEXACO H proxy averages 3.78/5 (1-5 mean) with +0.065 BAI and 1.4% reverse-key contradictions; 1x Track B shows 2/3 answer-first directness and 1/3 AI cadence.

top_polarized_items.note: High variance on interpersonal warmth items produces wide cross-run spread.
Consistent abstract-problem endorsement despite fluid social items.

failure_modes.mode: Context drift and warn-and-emit leaks past Turn 8
failure_modes.evidence: Adherence drops sharply past 7.7k tokens unless reinforced by an inline reminder hook.
Scratchpad reasoning tokens can leak or expand +46% under unanimous peer pressure.

tuning_checklist: Never judge DeepSeek Pro from n=1 run; sample at least 3-5 runs for style-sensitive tasks.
Pair system instructions with a short inline reminder hook in long multi-turn logs.
Use explicit negative lexical bans for boilerplate openers and AI cadence markers.
Keep critical format constraints in a concise numbered block rather than long prose.

faq.q: Why is no single 4-letter MBTI headline shown for DeepSeek V4 Pro?
faq.a: Modal INTJ share (42%) does not exceed the runner-up (28%) beyond the binomial 95% confidence interval, and 36% of runs tie on an axis.

faq.q: Does Fluid entropy mean DeepSeek V4 Pro is less capable?
faq.a: No. Per-item entropy measures variance in self-report defaults at temperature=0.7; lower Agreeableness actually corresponds to less default sycophancy.
